records.Concise description: Defunct early Bitcoin exchange that once dominated BTC trading and whose 2014 collapse became a defining custody and market-structure event.
records.Deeper researched summary: Mt. Gox began as a non-Bitcoin project, was converted into a Bitcoin exchange in 2010 and became the dominant early centralized BTC marketplace. It suspended withdrawals and ceased exchange operations in 2014 amid large bitcoin losses and insolvency proceedings. The exchange remains inactive; the live MtGox site is a rehabilitation-creditor portal, not evidence of resumed exchange service. As of August 2026, the trustee has extended specified repayment deadlines to October 31, 2026.
Creators / founders: Jed McCaleb — created the Mt. Gox Bitcoin exchange
records.Launch / history: Bitcoin exchange operations began in 2010; ownership transferred to Mark Karpelès in 2011. Mt. Gox ceased exchange operations in February 2014 and entered insolvency/rehabilitation proceedings.
records.Why it matters in the Bitcoin exchange e: Mt. Gox is essential to understanding early Bitcoin price discovery, the risks of centralized custody and the maturation of exchange operational practices.
Important technical or cultural characte: Current trustee portal is not an active exchange
records.Verification basis: Current MtGox rehabilitation-trustee notices verify that exchange service is not operating and document the 2026 repayment deadline; historical cessation is corroborated by primary legal records.
Research notes / uncertainties: The current website is a creditor/rehabilitation portal; lifecycle remains INACTIVE.
Repayment deadlines and creditor status are time-sensitive; as of verification, specified deadlines are 2026-10-31.
Avoid attributing unproven criminal responsibility; separate operational loss, insolvency and later prosecutions.

records.Concise description: Defunct Bitcoin exchange that operated from 2011 until U.S.-coordinated law-enforcement action shut it down in 2017.
records.Deeper researched summary: BTC-e was a major early exchange with BTC/fiat and crypto markets and unusually limited customer-identification controls. U.S. Department of Justice records state it operated from around 2011 until law enforcement shut it down around July 2017 and processed more than $9 billion in transactions. In 2024 operator Alexander Vinnik pleaded guilty to money-laundering conspiracy tied to BTC-e. This is a historical profile, not an endorsement or security ranking.
Creators / founders: BTC-e operators, including Alexander Vinnik — operator identified in U.S. court records
records.Launch / history: Operated from approximately 2011 until its shutdown in July 2017. U.S. authorities pursued operators and assessed AML-related penalties; Vinnik pleaded guilty in 2024.
records.Why it matters in the Bitcoin exchange e: BTC-e was a major early global BTC liquidity venue and illustrates how anonymous/weakly identified exchange infrastructure intersected with later AML enforcement.
Important technical or cultural characte: Minimal KYC/AML according to U.S. primary records

Corroborating sources.label: U.S. DOJ — BTC-e operator guilty plea

records.Verification basis: U.S. DOJ primary court-related material verifies BTC-e's 2011–2017 operation, law-enforcement shutdown and Vinnik's 2024 guilty plea.
Research notes / uncertainties: Use exact legal language: Vinnik pleaded guilty; do not generalize allegations against every BTC-e participant.
Do not infer current operation from successor/lookalike domains.

records.Concise description: Closed P2P Bitcoin marketplace that matched buyers and sellers worldwide while providing platform-controlled wallet/escrow services.
records.Deeper researched summary: LocalBitcoins launched in Finland in 2012 and became the canonical early web marketplace for local and online fiat-for-BTC trades. Unlike later multisig/non-custodial P2P systems, LocalBitcoins relied on platform accounts and escrow custody. The company announced closure in February 2023: new signups and trading stopped, with the remaining site focused on withdrawals rather than an operating exchange.
records.Launch / history: Founded in 2012. LocalBitcoins grew into a global P2P BTC marketplace and shut down trading in February 2023 after more than a decade of operation.
records.Why it matters in the Bitcoin exchange e: It shaped the global P2P Bitcoin on-ramp model and is the historical reference point against which newer non-custodial P2P designs are often compared.
Important technical or cultural characte: Wide range of fiat payment methods
Withdrawal-only remnants do not equal active exchange service
records.Verification basis: LocalBitcoins' own closure page verifies that signups/trading ended in February 2023 and remaining access is not normal exchange operation.
Research notes / uncertainties: A reachable withdrawal/closure page does not establish ACTIVE status.
Do not describe LocalBitcoins as non-custodial; platform wallet/escrow custody was a core feature.

records.Entity / project type: Defunct / wound-down custodial P2P Bitcoin marketplace
records.Concise description: P2P Bitcoin marketplace that operated platform wallets and trade escrow before its final wind-down and withdrawal-only state.
records.Deeper researched summary: Paxful was a prominent global P2P marketplace for bitcoin and fiat payment methods, using platform accounts and escrow rather than the on-chain user-controlled multisig model used by Hodl Hodl or Bisq. The company went through a 2023 suspension/restart and later announced a final shutdown/wind-down; current official material describes trade/deposit services as stopped while withdrawals remain available. Lifecycle is therefore INACTIVE despite a reachable site.
records.Launch / history: Founded in 2015. Paxful became a major P2P Bitcoin marketplace, temporarily suspended operations in 2023, later restarted, and announced final wind-down effective November 1, 2025.
records.Why it matters in the Bitcoin exchange e: It is important to P2P exchange history because it scaled custodial web-escrow trading across many fiat payment methods before newer non-custodial designs gained prominence.
records.Verification basis: Paxful's current wind-down page says the marketplace has shut down and trading/deposits have stopped; its closure announcement dates the final wind-down to 2025-11-01.
Research notes / uncertainties: Current status must be rechecked if Paxful announces a new operating successor; as verified, trade/deposit service was shut and only withdrawal/wind-down access remained.
Do not conflate shareholder/founder disputes with lifecycle facts unless directly relevant and sourced.
